QuestInfo.name: [NLC] The Altar of the Krakians
QuestInfo.0: Is there no way to gain entry to the Krakian ruins? Meet with Corine and see what options you have.
QuestInfo.1: Corine says that instead of a path leading into the city, she found the Altar of the Krakians. Defeat the Jungle Bear Warrior monsters to protect Corine while she investigates the altar.
QuestInfo.2: Though you investigated the Krakian ruins, the altar seemed like it had never been used, and no useful information could be gleaned from it. Investigate the other altars.

mob.0: If you were to fell about 300 Jungle Bear Warriors, that should make it safe enough to enter.
